```python
import fitz, io
from PIL import Image
import pytesseract

path = "IPCC_AR6_SYR_LongerReport.pdf"
doc = fitz.open(path)

def ocr_page(pno):
    page = doc[pno]
    pix = page.get_pixmap(dpi=200)
    img = Image.open(io.BytesIO(pix.tobytes("png")))
    txt = pytesseract.image_to_string(img)
    return txt

pages_to_check = list(range(66, 72))  # 1-indexed pages 67-72
results = {}
for p in pages_to_check:
    if p < doc.page_count:
        t = ocr_page(p)
        if "nuclear" in t.lower():
            results[p+1] = t

print("OCR pages with 'nuclear':", list(results.keys()))
for k,v in results.items():
    snip = " ".join(v.split())[:300]
    print(f"Page {k} OCR snippet:", snip)
```
